clips.title: The story
paras: In western Duskwood, Raven Hill lies in ruins beneath the shadow of its vast cemetery. Frightened squatters and invisible spirits are all that remain of the once lively human settlement.

Raven Hill stands along Duskwood’s western road, just north of Addle’s Stead, a shell of its former self. When dark magic and undead horrors swept through the Grand Hamlet region, the living fled east toward Darkshire or left the territory. Now ruined timber homes decay beneath the gloom. Travelers avoid them, fearing restless dead from the neighboring cemetery and the invisible Unseen among the crumbling walls.

Only a handful remain among Raven Hill’s ruins. Jitters, a nervous adventurer, hides in the abandoned structures, terrified of the horrors stalking the woods. In a dilapidated attic, the goblin Bliztik ekes out a solitary living by selling supplies to wary passersby. They share the ruins with the invisible spirits called the Unseen, at the edge of the sprawling burial grounds.
